title: Chunk an Array
prompt: A gallery loads items in rows of a fixed size. Write a function that splits the array into groups of the given size, in order. The final group may be smaller if the array does not divide evenly.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Chunk an Array, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A gallery loads items in rows of a fixed size. Write a function that splits the array into groups of the given size, in order. The final group may be smaller if the array does not divide evenly. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure JavaScript function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases. The main practice area is arrays and slicing. Pay attention to edge cases and keep the transformation predictable as the input grows.
